definitionZh: Min-width CSS 属性设定元素最小宽度 。 它防止宽度属性的用值变得小于指定的毫微宽值.
sourceDefinition: The min-width CSS property sets the minimum width of an element. It prevents the used value of the width property from becoming smaller than the value specified for min-width.
